name: Alice in Dreamworld
source:
It is an unfamiliar world Airi face just after waking up.
That is the "Dreamworld" where people dream their dream...

She meets many people as led by a mysterious guy in all white clothes.
Somehow strange people living in the dreamworld welcomes her openmindedly.

But, a sudden gunshot tells the beginning of the "game".

"Well, the killing game has started now..."

Can Airi gets back to her world from the "Dreamworld"...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ162930.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
刚醒来的爱理面对的是一个陌生的世界。
那就是人们梦想的“梦想世界”……

她在一个身穿白衣的神秘男子的带领下遇到了很多人。
不知何故，生活在梦境世界中的陌生人们以开放的态度欢迎她。

然而，突然的枪声却宣告了“游戏”的开始。

“好了，杀戮游戏现在开始了……”

爱理能否从“梦境世界”回到自己的世界……？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ162930.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
